title: Start / stop station
brief: Program a conveyor with a momentary Start button and a momentary Stop button. The operator must not have to hold Start to keep the motor running.
requirements: Initially, the conveyor motor must be OFF. Start PB is ON while the Start button is pressed and OFF when it is released.
The physical Stop button is normally closed: Stop Healthy is ON when Stop is released and OFF when Stop is pressed.
Pressing Start while Stop is released must start the conveyor. Releasing Start must leave it running.
Pressing Stop must switch the motor OFF immediately, even if Start is being held down. Stop must take priority while both buttons are pressed.
After stopping, releasing Stop with Start released must not restart the motor. Press Start again to start it.
objective: Understand latching, stop priority and physical switch wiring.
hints: Stop Healthy is a TRUE permissive, so use an NO ladder contact for it.
Place the Start input and motor feedback in parallel, with Stop Healthy outside the branch.
